messages.content: Thank you so much for taking the time to meet with me today, Professor Matthews. I really appreciate it.
Of course, Malena. What can I do for you?

Well, I was hoping to get your advice on something. I've been thinking about applying for a research fellowship, but I'm not sure if it's the right decision for me. I wanted to talk to you about it and see what you think.

That's a great question, Malena. There are a few things you should consider before making a decision like this. First of all, do some research and make sure you understand what the fellowship entails. It's important to know what kind of commitment you're making and what will be expected of you if you're accepted. You should also think about whether or not this is the right time for you to take on such a project. If you're still finishing up your coursework or preparing for exams, it might not be the best time to apply for a fellowship. On the other hand, if you have some extra time and energy that you can devote to a research project, then it might be a good idea to go ahead and apply. Just be sure to weigh all of your options carefully before making a decision.

Yeah, that makes sense. I definitely want to do some more research and make sure I understand everything before I make a decision. But I'm definitely interested in applying. Do you think I have a good chance of being accepted?

Well, Malena, you're an excellent student with a lot of potential. I think you would be a strong candidate for a fellowship. But it's always competitive, so there's no guarantee that you'll be accepted. Just make sure you put your best foot forward and put together a strong application.
I'm sorry, mom. I didn't mean to pick up the wrong bag.
I told you to carry the blue bag, but you picked up the green one instead.
I know, I'm sorry. It won't happen again.
It better not. Now give me the green bag and go get the blue one.
Okay.
Niyah, I'm disappointed in you. I expect better from you.
Mom, can I please have a new toy?
What's in it for me?
I'll be happy.
That's not enough. What else?
I'll help you around the house more.
Okay, that's a start. Let me think about it and I'll get back to you.
It's just a toy, but my niece is going to be so disappointed.
I'm sorry, Jozef. I know you're trying your best.
It's not good enough! This was supposed to be for her birthday and now she won't have it.
Maybe you could try looking online?
I did! And the store doesn't sell it anymore.
That sucks.
I feel so alone all of a sudden.
You're not alone. I'm still here with you.
But everyone else is gone. It feels like I'm the only one left in the world.
Ursula, there's nothing wrong with feeling lonely sometimes. We all feel that way at times. But you don't have to be alone if you don't want to be. I'm here for you, and I'll always be here for you.
Thank you, Rebeka. That means a lot to me.
You're welcome, Ursula. I care about you a lot, and I don't want to see you feeling lonely or sad. If you ever need anything, just let me know and I'll be there for you.
Wow, your house is really big and clean! And these paintings are amazing! Where did you get them?
Most of them were done by my father. He's a professional artist. But a few of them are from other family members.
That's incredible! I had no idea your father was an artist. He must be really talented.
Yes, he is. He's been painting since he was a child and he's won many awards over the years. His work is actually in some major museums around the world.
That's amazing! I'm so impressed. Do you paint as well?
No, I don't. But I do appreciate art and I enjoy visiting museums and galleries.
Hey, Arthur. What's up?
Not much, what's up with you?
Just hanging out, same as always.
Yeah, I guess so. Hey, did you hear about that new restaurant that opened up downtown?
No, I hadn't heard about it. What's it called?
It's called the Happy Haus. They serve German food.
I think a hamster would be perfect for you, Bernadette. You can watch it play and it will be a fun new addition to the family.
I don't know, Irina. I'm not sure if I'm ready for a pet yet.
Come on, Bernadette! It will be so much fun! You can name it and everything.
Well...I guess it couldn't hurt to try.
Great! I'll go get one from the pet store right now.
Okay, but let me know when you're getting it so I can be prepared.
I really don't understand this concept. Could you please explain it to me?
Well, Mahogany, let's see if we can break it down. Do you remember what we talked about yesterday in class?
Yes, we were discussing the different types of angles.

That's right. So, when two lines intersect, they form angles. There are four different types of angles- right angles, acute angles, obtuse angles, and straight angles. Now do you remember how to identify each type of angle?

Yes. A right angle is formed when the lines intersect at a 90 degree angle. An acute angle is less than 90 degrees. An obtuse angle is more than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees. And a straight angle is exactly 180 degrees.
That's correct! Now let's apply that knowledge to this problem. Can you take a look at this diagram and tell me what kind of angle is formed where the lines intersect?
Wow, I can't believe it! The boss was so impressed with my presentation that he gave me a raise on the spot! I'm feeling pretty good about myself right now.
That's great news, Chantz! Congratulations!
Thanks. It's nice to be recognized for all the hard work I've been putting in.
You deserve it. So what are you going to do with the extra money?
Well, I was thinking about taking a trip to Europe this summer. What do you think?
That sounds like a great idea! I'm sure you'll have a blast.
Hey, I'm sorry for cancelling on you last minute. I know we were supposed to hang out today, but something came up and I really can't miss it.
Oh, no worries at all! What happened?
It's my family. We're going to be spending some time together and I really don't want to miss out on it.
Aww, that's so sweet of you! I'm sure they'll appreciate it.
Yeah, I hope so. It's just been a while since we've all been able to get together and I don't want to miss the chance.
Absolutely. Your family is more important than hanging out with me any day. So don't worry about it!
Hey, John. I'm going to the cemetery today. My mom died a few months ago and I really miss her.
I'm so sorry, Emani. That must be really tough for you.
Yeah, it is. I just wish I could see her one more time.
It's natural to feel that way after someone close to you dies. Have you been to the cemetery before?
No, I haven't been yet. I'm kind of scared to go, but I know I need to do it.
Well, if you want, I'll go with you.
Hey, how are you doing today?
I'm doing alright, considering everything that's going on. How about you?
I'm hanging in there. It's been tough lately, but I'm trying to stay positive.
That's good. I know it's not easy, but it's important to stay strong.
Thanks. I appreciate your support.
No problem, that's what friends are for. So, what's been going on? Anything new?
I'm so glad I was able to help you with your groceries! It looked like you were struggling a bit and I just wanted to lend a helping hand.
Oh, thank you so much! I really appreciate it. I don't know what I would have done without your help.
It's no problem at all! I'm just happy that I could help out.
Well, thank you again. You're really kindhearted and it's people like you that make the world a better place.
Aw, thank you so much! That means a lot coming from you.
Anytime! Have a great day!
I hate spending time with my family. They're always arguing and I can never get a break from the drama.
Korie, you should appreciate your family. They love you and are always there for you, even if it seems like they're arguing a lot.
But I can't stand it when they argue. It's so loud and annoying.
Well, maybe you should try to understand why they're arguing and see if there's anything you can do to help resolve the situation.
I don't know...I just wish I could go on the trip to get away from them and have some peace and quiet.
Korie, your father and I have been talking, and we think it would be good for you to spend some time with your family. We think it would be good for you to go on the trip with us.
Hey, Mom.
Hey, Auggie. How are you doing?
I'm good. Hey, can I ask you something?
Sure. What is it?
Do you think people will always see me the way they do now? As someone who's different? Or do you think that eventually they'll just see me as Tiona?

Well, Auggie, I think it depends on the person. Some people might always see you as someone who's different, and that's not necessarily a bad thing. But I think there are also people who will come to see you as just Tiona, and that's because they'll get to know you and they'll understand that you're just like them, even though you look different on the outside. So I think it really varies from person to person.
Teacher: Great job, Tommy! You definitely deserve a gold star for your excellent work.
Thank you so much! I'm really excited and proud to have earned it.
It feels great to be recognized for my hard work.
You've worked very hard, and you should be proud of your accomplishments.
I'm worried about the time. I want to be early so I can find a good seat. I also don't want to miss anything important.
Why are you so worried about being early?
I don't want to be late and have to sit in the back. I want to be able to see and hear everything that's going on.
But if you're early, won't you just end up sitting around waiting?
No, I'll find something to do. I might go over the material one more time or talk to some of the other attendees. There's always something to do when you're early.
I see your point. Being early is definitely better than being late.
Ana, I really need to talk to you. I'm feeling so lost and confused right now.
What's going on, Jennings? You sound really upset.

I am. I got kicked out of my house yesterday and now I don't know what to do. I miss my family and I want to go back home, but I'm so embarrassed and ashamed of what I did that I don't know if that's even possible anymore.
Jennings, it's okay. You made a mistake, but your family loves you and they will forgive you. Just tell them how sorry you are and that you want to come home. They will let you back in, I promise.
But what if they don't? What if they're so disappointed in me that they can't forgive me? I don't think I could handle that.
Jennings, you have to try. You need to go home and face your family. They love you and they will forgive you, I'm sure of it.
I'm really disappointed with my sentence. I was hoping for a shorter sentence, but two years is a long time.
I'm sorry to hear that. We did the best we could, but the judge didn't see it our way.
What am I going to do for two years?
You'll have to make the best of it. There are plenty of people in prison who make the most of their time and come out better people.
I don't know if I can do that.
You'll have to try. It's not going to be easy, but you can do it.
So, what do you think of my room?
I like it! It's really cozy. And I love all of your posters. You've got some great taste in music.
Yeah, I'm glad you like it. I was a little nervous about what you might think. But it's nice to know that we have similar taste in things.
Yeah, definitely. It makes hanging out more fun when you have things in common with the person you're with.
So, do you want to watch a movie or something? I have a few in mind that I think you'll like.
Sure, that sounds great!
Thank you so much for this opportunity, I won't let you down.
You've certainly earned it. You've been one of our most dedicated and hardworking employees since you started here, and I know you'll do great things in this new role.
Thank you, I'm excited to get started and make a difference.
I have no doubt you will. You have a lot of great ideas, and I know you'll be able to put them into action in this new role.
The government isn't doing enough to help people during this crisis. They're not providing enough resources or support. I think they could be doing more to help us.
What do you think they should be doing?

Well, for starters, they could provide more financial assistance to people who have lost their jobs or businesses. They could also give free healthcare to everyone, regardless of income or insurance status. And they could provide more food and supplies to those who are struggling to get by. There are a lot of things that the government could be doing to help us, but they're not doing nearly enough.
Yeah, I agree. The government could definitely be doing more to help us. But we can't just rely on them to do everything for us. We need to help ourselves and our communities as much as we can.
Hey, Anahi. I wanted to talk to you about something.
What's up?
I wanted to ask you about the money you donated to build my last church.
of course! I was happy to help out. The church is beautiful, by the way. You must be very proud of it. What did you want to know?
Well, I was wondering if you would be interested in donating money to help build another church.
Another church? Why do you need another one?
Mom, can we go to the park again? I promise I'll stay warm this time.
No, it's still too cold outside. Let's wait a little longer.
But I really want to go! Please, just for a little bit? I'll dress warmly, I promise.
All right, fine. But you need to listen to me and come back inside if it starts to feel too cold. Understood?
That was an amazing movie! I loved it!
I know, right? It was so funny and badass. I loved how they included the whole Marvel Universe in it.
Yeah, that was my favorite part too! Seeing all of the different characters interact with each other. Did you see that one scene where Hulk and Thor were fighting?
Yeah, that was so cool! I love how they incorporated humor into the action scenes.
I know, right? The whole movie was just so entertaining. Did you have a favorite part?
Honestly, I think my favorite part was the beginning when Thor is captured by Surtur. I just thought it set up the rest of the movie well and it was really funny.
Hi, gorgeous.
Hey! You brought me flowers!
Yes, I wanted to show you how much I love you. I know roses are your favorite flower, so I thought this would be a perfect way to show you my feelings.
Aww, thank you so much! They're beautiful! *kisses him*
You're welcome. Seeing you smile is all the thanks I need.
So, what's up with you?
Hi, how are you doing?
Not too good. I'm just really bored in here and frustrated.
Yeah, I can imagine. It's tough being stuck in a small space like this with nothing to do.
Yeah. And on top of that, the food is terrible.
Yeah, that's another thing I was going to mention. The food here is really not good at all. You might want to try and supplement your diet with some snacks or other food items from the commissary.
Yeah, that's a good idea. But it's hard to afford anything on the little bit of money we make here.
Hi! I'd like to buy this chocolate cake with chocolate frosting, please.
Sure! That'll be $4.99.
Great, thank you!
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you so much for trusting me with this, I really appreciate it.
You're welcome, Conor. I know I can count on you to do a great job while I'm gone.
Absolutely, don't worry about a thing. I'll take good care of the store for you.
Thank you, Conor. I really appreciate it. Have a great day!
Hey, I tried a new route to school today and it was shorter and faster than my old one.
Really? What was the route?
I walked for two blocks, then turned left and walked for one block before turning right.
That sounds like a great route! I might have to try it myself.
Hi Kacen!
Hey Jestin, what's up?
Not much, just getting everything ready for your surprise birthday party!
Oh wow, you really went all out! I'm so surprised and touched that you did this for me. Thank you so much!
It was no problem at all. I just wanted to make sure that your birthday was extra special this year.
Well, you definitely succeeded! I can't wait to see everyone and have some fun. Thanks again, Jestin.
Boss, I'm really sorry, but I don't think I can come in today. I'm feeling really sick.
Maile, I'm sorry to hear that. But we really need you today. Can you at least come in for a few hours?
Boss, I appreciate your offer, but I don't think it would be wise for me to come in. I don't want to get anyone else sick.
Maile, we can't afford to have anyone else out today. If you could just come in for a few hours and help us out, it would be greatly appreciated.
Boss, like I said, I appreciate your offer. But I don't think it's a good idea for me to come in. Thanks anyway though.
Maile, are you sure there's nothing I can do to convince you to come in?
Sarah, I had so much fun dancing last night! I felt really happy and free. It was great to just let loose and move around.
That sounds like a lot of fun! I'm glad you had a good time.
Yeah, I did. I love dancing. It's one of my favorite things to do.
I can tell. You have a lot of energy when you dance.
I know! I just feel so alive when I'm dancing. It's like everything else disappears and I'm just in the moment.
That sounds amazing. I wish I could experience that.
Hey, I've been going to those aerobic classes three times a week for six months now.
Yeah, I can tell! You look great!
Thanks! I feel great too. My stamina has really increased and my overall fitness has improved.
That's awesome! How do you like the classes?
They're great! I love the feeling of pushing myself and getting a good workout. Plus, the other people in the class are really friendly and supportive.
That sounds like a lot of fun! I might have to check it out sometime.
Hey, um, I need to talk to you guys about something.
Of course, what is it?
It's just, well, I'm gay. And I know that might be hard for you to hear but it's the truth and I just wanted you to know.
(sighing) Oh, Johnathan. We love you no matter what. You're our son and we will always support you.
Really? You're not mad or anything?
No, of course not! We just want you to be happy and we'll do whatever we can to help make that happen.
So what seems to be the problem?
Well, my car won't start. I think it's the battery.
Okay, let's take a look. Do you have a jumper cable?
Yeah, I do.
Great. Let's hook up the jumper cable to your car and mine and see if that starts it.
All right. Thanks, Ivie.
Mom, I'm really upset about what happened today. I don't want to talk to anyone right now.
Why? What happened?
I don't want to talk about it.
Matthieu, you can't just not tell me what happened. Tell me what's wrong.
I don't want to talk about it, okay? Just leave me alone.
Matthieu, I'm your mother and I love you. You can tell me anything.
Hey Brayan, what's up?
What's up with you not responding to my requests? You always ignore me.
I'm sorry, I didn't mean to ignore you. I've just been really busy lately.
That's no excuse. You always have time for your other friends, but you never have time for me.
I'm sorry, Brayan. I'll try to do better.
Yeah, you better.
Hey, boss. I know I've only been working here for a few months, but I was wondering if I could talk to you about a raise.
Arayah, we just can't afford to give raises right now. We're barely keeping our head above water as it is.
But I'm doing great work! I've increased sales by 10% in my department and I'm always one of the first to arrive in the morning and the last to leave at night.
Your hard work is appreciated, but like I said, we just can't afford it right now. Maybe in a few months when business is doing better.
Well, if that's the case, then I'm afraid I'll have to hand in my notice.
What? You're quitting? Just because we can't give you a raise?

You're always doing this, Sarah. You're always trying to take control and be in charge, and it drives me crazy. I can't stand it when you're always telling me what to do or how to do things. I want to be able to do things my own way, and I don't want to feel like I'm constantly being managed by you.

I'm not trying to take control, Jaron. I just want us to be on the same page and for things to go smoothly between us. I don't like it when we're constantly arguing or when you're constantly pushing me away.
I don't like it either, but that's because you're always trying to control everything. It feels like you're never letting me have a say in anything, and it's really frustrating.
I'm sorry that you feel that way, Jaron. I'm just trying to make sure that we're both happy and that our relationship is healthy.
I know you are, but it's still really frustrating. I just wish you would let me have more control over things.
I'll try to do that, Jaron. I'm sorry that it's been so difficult for you.
I'm so glad I could help you clear up the dishes from dinner. It feels good to be helpful.
I know, me too. I always feel better when I can help out around here. Plus, it's nice to have some company while I clean up.
Absolutely! I feel like we've been spending a lot more time together lately and I really enjoy it.
Yeah, I do too. We've been through a lot together lately and it's nice to have someone to rely on.
Definitely. So, what do you want to do now? Watch a movie or something?
That sounds great! Let me just finish up these last few dishes and then we can relax for the rest of the evening.
Hey there, Raven. I've noticed you're always by yourself. What are you up to?
Just thinking.
About what?
Life, the universe, everything.
That's pretty deep. I don't think I could handle thinking about that stuff all the time.
It's not easy, but it's worth it.
Hey Kristan, I noticed that you've been struggling lately. I just wanted to come over and encourage you.
Yeah, things have been pretty tough. I'm just finding it hard to get through everything.
I know it's tough, but if you can push through this, you'll be a stronger person for it. Just remember that you're not alone in this and I'm here for you if you need anything.
Thanks Aline, that means a lot to me. Just knowing that I have your support makes me feel better already.
Of course, that's what friends are for. Now let's get through this together, okay?
Alright, let's do it.
Mom, I'm so glad you're here. I've been feeling really down lately.
Oh, sweetie, what's wrong?
I don't know. I just feel like I'm not going anywhere in life. I hate being stuck in this place. I wish I could live on my own like other people.
It's tough, I know. But you're doing the best you can given your circumstances. And we all love you very much. You're not alone in this world, no matter how it may feel sometimes.
I know, but it's just so hard. I feel like I'm missing out on so much.
I know, sweetie. But you're not missing out on anything that you can't handle. You're a strong person, and you'll get through this.
I did it! I said the whole alphabet!
That's great, Rashawn! You've worked really hard on this. How does it feel to finally be able to do it?
It feels really good! I'm so happy I can do it!
That's terrific! Keep up the good work and you'll be able to achieve anything you set your mind to.
Hey, boss. I'm not feeling too great today. I think I'm going to have to call in sick.
Oh, no! What's wrong?
I don't know. I just don't feel well.
Do you have a fever?
No, but I just feel really tired and my stomach doesn't feel great.
Okay, well why don't you go home and rest? We can manage without you today. Get better soon!
I can't believe you didn't help me with the party planning like you said you would. I trusted you and you let me down.
Dominik, I'm sorry. I know I said I would help but then my schedule got really busy and I just couldn't fit it in.
But you promised! You said you would be there for me and now the party is a mess because of your lack of help!
Dominik, please calm down. I'm sorry, okay? Let me try to make it up to you. What can I do to help now?
I'm really happy right now. I feel like everything is perfect. I don't want this moment to end.

I know how you feel. It's like everything finally feels right and you just want to hold onto that feeling forever. But eventually the moment will end and we'll have to go back to our everyday lives. But it's nice to know that we can always look back on this moment and remember how happy we were.
Yeah, I know. It's just hard to accept that things can't always be this perfect. But I'm glad we have each other to lean on when things aren't going so well.
Absolutely. We're in this together, no matter what happens.
It's great to finally be here. I've been looking forward to this all week.
I know, me too! This is my favorite place to unwind and relax. The people here are so friendly and the atmosphere is just perfect.
Yes, I can definitely see why you like it here so much. It's exactly what I need after a long day at work.
So, what do you do?
I'm a software engineer. I design and develop computer programs.
That sounds interesting! I'm a web developer myself. Maybe we could collaborate on something sometime?
I'm sorry to interrupt, but I think we may be breaking one of the rules.
What rule is that?
Well, I noticed that we've been talking a lot in class lately without raising our hands first. And I just wanted to make sure that we're following the rules.

Thank you for bringing that to my attention, Sanya. Yes, you're right, we are supposed to raise our hands before speaking in class. I appreciate your reminding us of that rule. Let's try to do better from now on, okay?
Wow, a gold medal! Thank you so much, mom!
You're welcome, Dezirae. You did a great job finding that lost kitten.
I'm so glad I could help. Do you think the owner is going to be okay?
Yes, I'm sure they are. They were probably just worried sick about their little cat. But thanks to you, they can be reunited once again.
That makes me feel really good.
I'm glad, because you deserve it. You're a very kind and caring person, Dezirae.
It's raining, so I'm wearing my rubber boots.
Yeah, it is. I can't believe how much it's come down already.
I know, right? It's crazy. I hope it stops soon though, I don't want to have to keep these boots on all day.
Yeah, me too. I hate getting wet and cold.
I know, it's the worst. But at least we have our rubber boots to keep us dry.
Yeah, that's true. I'm just glad it's not snowing. That would be even worse.
I can't believe this traffic! We're never going to make it on time at this rate.
I know, I'm really sorry. I should have left the house earlier.
It's not your fault, but now we're both going to be late. This is ridiculous!
I know. I feel terrible about it.
Well, there's nothing we can do now. We'll just have to wait it out.
Yeah, I guess so.
Hey. I'm here for you.
Thank you, Emely. Just knowing you're here makes me feel a little better.
Of course. I'm your friend. I'll always be here for you, no matter what happens.
Thank you. I really appreciate that.
Any time. So, do you want to talk about what happened?
I don't know if I'm ready to talk about it yet. It's still so fresh and raw.
Excuse me, waiter. This restaurant is very noisy. I'm having a hard time hearing myself think.
I'm sorry to hear that, sir. We'll do our best to keep the noise level down. Is there anything else I can do for you?
Yes, actually. I'm still hungry after all this food. Do you have any recommendations for dessert?
Our chocolate cake is very popular.
Hey, are you up for going out to eat tonight? I'm really in the mood for some good food.
Absolutely! Where did you have in mind?
I was thinking maybe we could go to that new Italian place that just opened up. What do you think?
Sounds great! I love Italian food. Let me check and see if my husband is free to join us and then I'll let you know.
Ok, sounds good. I'll talk to you soon.
Hey, it looks like my husband can join us after all. He's just finishing up at work and then he'll meet us at the restaurant.
Hi, I'd like to buy this box of laundry detergent please.
That'll be $5.99.
Okay, here you go.
Thanks for your purchase!
No problem, thank you.
Do you need help carrying that to your car?
I'm finally free! I can't believe it.
I can't believe it either. I'm so happy for you.
It feels amazing to be out of that place. I was planning my escape for weeks.
How did you do it?
I packed a bag with clothes and food and left in the middle of the night. I felt free as soon as I walked away from the prison. Finally, I can start a new life.
I'm so proud of you. I know it wasn't easy, but you did it.
Hey, thanks for coming over man. It's been a while since we've all hung out.
No problem, dude. Your place is sweet. I love the view from your back porch.
Yeah, it's pretty great. I'm really lucky to have found this place.
So, how have you been? I feel like I haven't seen you in forever.
I've been good. Just busy with work and stuff. You know how it is.
Yeah, I know how it is. But it's good to see you nonetheless.
Hey Dad. I got a C on my math test.
Treyson, what happened?
I didn't study and I failed the test.
Why didn't you study? You know how important math is.
I don't know. I just didn't feel like it.
Treyson, you have to take responsibility for your own education. If you don't study, you're not going to do well in school.
Hey, what's up?
Not much, what about you?
I'm good. Just getting ready for the weekend. What are your plans?
I'm not sure yet. I was thinking about going to the movies or something. What about you?
I don't know. I was thinking about maybe going shopping or something.
That sounds like fun. Do you want to meet up on Saturday and do something together?
Mom, can I talk to you for a second?
Of course, sweetie. What's on your mind?
I just wanted to tell you how much I appreciated your support during my first opera. It meant a lot to me.
Oh, Henrry, I'm so proud of you! You sounded amazing out there. I could tell that you were really enjoying yourself.
Yeah, I was. It was an incredible experience. The applause from the audience made it all worth it.
Well, you deserved it, sweetheart. You worked so hard leading up to the performance. I know it wasn't easy, but you did an amazing job.
